title: Clopen geometric factorisation of a commutative proper/open square
statement: Let p : B → D and r : C → E be proper morphisms of schemes, and let k : C → B and i : E → D be quasi-compact open immersions with k ≫ p = r ≫ i. Then there exists a scheme V and maps b : V → B, s : V → E, and t : C → V such that b ≫ p = s ≫ i, t ≫ b = k, and t ≫ s = r; b and t are open immersions, s is proper, and t is a closed immersion.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, case (b), with Tags 01W4 and 01W6 for proper immersions and clopen factorisation.

proof.text: Take V to be the fibre product B ×_D E with its projections b and s. Base change preserves properness and open immersions. The commutative square induces the unique map t with the displayed equations. It is an open immersion by base change of k and the open identification of b; it is proper over the separated morphism s because r is proper, hence it is a proper immersion and therefore a closed immersion.
